summary: The dossiers were mostly sound on team facts, which match the current facts (record, West finals loss, trades, Mara, Cup group, key dates). Three live checks found location errors: the outlet center is now OKC Outlets on I-40, Ma Der Lao Kitchen is in the Plaza District, and Shop Good is in Automobile Alley. Other fixes cover the Hornets' 2005-07 history, Durant's titles, Collison's dates, Memphis's division, the banner night, the WCWS venue name and the Jones Assembly neighborhood. An invented SoSo slang term is gone. OKC didn't get Specter. The brief still needs work on Chanchaleune as Asian District anchor, Shop Good's placement, the 2026-27 vs 2027-28 City Edition framing, past-dated 2026 windows and the Oct 22 home status. Small businesses and 2027 event dates are queued as unverifiable.
